# ERP Academy

> ERP Academy by Akshay is India's leading SAP training institute specializing in SAP MM, SAP HANA, and SAP FI certification with 100% placement support.

ERP Academy provides live, hands-on training led by senior SAP consultant Akshay Kumar (6+ years enterprise consulting and training experience). Over 500+ professionals trained with a 95% placement record at top MNCs like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini, Deloitte, and PwC.

## Core Courses

- [SAP MM Training Course](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/courses/sap-mm): Comprehensive 10-12 weeks training on procurement lifecycle, inventory management, master data (BP), OBYC automatic account determination, and S/4HANA sourcing.
- [SAP HANA Training Course](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/courses/sap-hana): In-memory computing, Calculation Views, CDS Views, AMDP, SLT data provisioning, and S/4HANA migration.
- [SAP FI Training Course](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/courses/sap-fi): General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, and S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA).
